base.PHYSICAL_HIGH: Your physical cycle is in its high phase today. The body has its resources at hand: effort comes more easily and recovery is faster. It's a good time for physical activity, a project that demands energy, or moving forward on what matters to you. The higher the percentage, the more this vitality is felt.
base.PHYSICAL_LOW: Your physical cycle is in its low phase today. The body is rebuilding its reserves: it asks for rest and gentleness rather than performance. This is the moment to slow down, listen to your limits and postpone whatever demands an intense effort. The lower the percentage, the stronger this need for recovery.
base.PHYSICAL_CRITICAL: Your physical cycle is at its turning point today: the curve is crossing from one phase to the other. On these days the body is less steady, more prone to missteps and sudden dips in energy. A day to stay attentive to your sensations and avoid abrupt efforts.
base.EMOTIONAL_HIGH: Your emotional cycle is in its high phase today. Exchanges with others flow more easily, your mood is lighter and more communicative. It's a good day for reunions, an important conversation, or expressing what you feel. The higher the percentage, the more marked this ease.
base.EMOTIONAL_LOW: Your emotional cycle is in its low phase today. You might feel more sensitive, more introspective, or in need of calm. It's a good time to be gentle with yourself and avoid exchanges that demand a lot of emotional energy. The lower the percentage, the stronger this need to withdraw.
base.EMOTIONAL_CRITICAL: Your emotional cycle is at its turning point today. On these days moods shift faster and reactions are less predictable, in either direction. A day to live with a little more indulgence toward yourself and toward others.
base.INTELLECTUAL_HIGH: Your intellectual cycle is in its high phase today. Concentration, memory and problem-solving are favored. It's a good time for tasks that demand reflection, an important decision, or new learning. The higher the percentage, the sharper the mind.
base.INTELLECTUAL_LOW: Your intellectual cycle is in its low phase today. Concentration is harder to muster and the mind needs a breather. Favor simple, routine tasks rather than complex decisions or heavy memorization. The lower the percentage, the more noticeable this slowdown.
base.INTELLECTUAL_CRITICAL: Your intellectual cycle is at its turning point today. On these days attention scatters more easily and slips of inattention are more frequent. A good day to double-check what matters rather than relying on your first impression.

synthesis.PHYSICAL-HIGH_EMOTIONAL-HIGH_INTELLECTUA: All three of your cycles are in their high phase today: body, heart and mind are moving in the same direction. It's a good moment to undertake, decide and enjoy this overall vitality. The higher the percentages, the more the day will carry you.
Body and heart are full of drive today, but the mind needs to slow down. Enjoy this beautiful physical and relational energy, while avoiding complex decisions that demand sustained concentration.
Your vitality and your heart are in great shape, but your mind is at its turning point. Move forward on what excites you, while double-checking the details that demand mental rigor.
synthesis.PHYSICAL-HIGH_EMOTIONAL-LOW_INTELLECTUAL: Your physical energy and mental clarity are excellent today, but your heart needs more gentleness. A good day to act and reflect, while allowing yourself some indulgence on the emotional front.
The body is in shape today, but the heart and mind need rest. Enjoy this physical energy to move, while avoiding exchanges or decisions that demand a lot of emotional or mental investment.

Your physical vitality is strong today, but the heart needs gentleness and the mind is at its turning point. Move and expend energy, while staying patient with your emotions and attentive to the details that matter.
synthesis.PHYSICAL-HIGH_EMOTIONAL-CRITICAL_INTELLE: Body and mind are in a beautiful dynamic today, while the heart is at its emotional turning point. It's a good time to act and decide, allowing yourself a little more indulgence on the mood front.

Your physical energy is beautiful today, but the heart is at its turning point and the mind needs to slow down. Favor movement and physical action rather than complex decisions or emotionally charged exchanges.

Only your physical energy is in its high phase today, with heart and mind both at their turning point. Use this vitality to move, while staying gentle with yourself and cautious about today's decisions.
synthesis.PHYSICAL-LOW_EMOTIONAL-HIGH_INTELLECTUAL: Your heart and mind are in great shape today, but the body needs rest. It's a good day for exchanges and reflection, sparing your physical energy and avoiding intense efforts.
Your heart is light today, but body and mind need gentleness. Enjoy good exchanges and warm relationships, while allowing yourself physical and mental rest.
Your sensitivity is beautiful and communicative today, while the body asks for rest and the mind is at its turning point. Favor warm exchanges, taking it gently for the rest of the day.
synthesis.PHYSICAL-LOW_EMOTIONAL-LOW_INTELLECTUAL-: Your mind is clear and sharp today, but body and heart need rest and calm. It's a good time to reflect and plan, while sparing yourself physically and emotionally.
Your three cycles are low today, a day that clearly invites rest. Allow yourself gentleness, lighten your schedule if possible, and give yourself time to recover on every level.
Body and heart need rest today, and the mind is at its turning point. A day to live at a slower pace, giving yourself plenty of gentleness and little demand on yourself.
synthesis.PHYSICAL-LOW_EMOTIONAL-CRITICAL_INTELLEC: Your mind is clear today, but the body needs rest and the heart is at its turning point. Use this mental clarity to move forward on thoughtful tasks, without asking too much of your body or emotions.
Body and mind are both in their low phase today, while the heart is at its turning point. A day to take very easy: little effort, few decisions, and patience with your shifting moods.
The body needs rest, while heart and mind are both at their turning point. A day to live gently, without particular expectations, honoring your need for calm.
synthesis.PHYSICAL-CRITICAL_EMOTIONAL-HIGH_INTELLE: Your heart and mind are in great shape today, while the body is at its physical turning point. Enjoy good exchanges and your mental clarity, staying attentive to your body's signals.
Your heart is light today, but the body is at its turning point and the mind needs rest. Enjoy warm exchanges, while keeping a gentle pace physically and mentally.

synthesis.PHYSICAL-CRITICAL_EMOTIONAL-LOW_INTELLEC: Your mind is clear today, but the body is at its turning point and the heart needs gentleness. Move forward on what demands reflection, while allowing yourself emotional indulgence and physical caution.
